evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks!A2:D2 and Internal Quality Checks!A2:D2 ask whether the prompt reads like a real person asking for an app; neither adds a row-1 annotation. The relevant skill procedure (references/quality-checks.md:9-11) calls for a cold read and identifies acceptance lists, spec tables, feature matrices and build recipes as defects. The actual task/instruction.md:1 opens 'I'd like a small code playground for trying out browser ideas' and describes editing, previewing and saving in first-person product terms. Line 3 supplies the practical motivation ('The annoying part with playgrounds is losing something that was working') and asks for recovery and protection from concurrent overwrites. Lines 5, 7 and 9 remain short connected paragraphs: supporting notes, ready-to-use initial content, keyboard/narrow-screen comfort, themes, and the delivery location. There are no numbered acceptance lists, shall/must tables, feature matrices, framework mandates or implementation steps in this main prompt. JavaScript/HTML/CSS at line 1 are the user's editable content formats. The brief runtime handoff at line 9 is compatible with the frozen template's separate integration note. Supporting task/environment/instructions/integration.md:3 expressly leaves frontend tools open; policy.md:5 leaves layout, labels, indentation, routes and fields to the builder. The six notes elaborate user-visible behavior without turning the main request into a build recipe. Adversarial thought experiments: a static editor/preview mock could coexist with this natural prose, but its broken behavior would not make this source-style row fail or establish app correctness; a conforming implementation choosing a different editor library, layout or API design still fits the request and is not excluded by row 1. These are source-based reasoning checks, not app executions. Independently recomputed the canonical manifest input hash and SHA256 of all 84 frozen task/rule files; every value matched the manifest. The instruction hash is 9f82c3aa08cd844a7acfd63c5b519e7df2b41be054a0223c1fffbc119f9d6f6e, root workbook hash is 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f, and skill hash is 8f2b660d1d32df90eb50990f401a0fc23a2ccbbcd49eeb5730bfbb9bef2bebc3. raw-evidence-index.json was absent at review time; no runtime measurement is necessary for this prose-only row, and this Pass makes no Oracle, model, portal, runtime, or whole-task clearance claim.
